privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How M. Dadu Films collects, uses, protects and shares information across its production, talent, casting, career and contact services.
body:
## 1. About this Privacy Policy
This Privacy Policy explains how M. Dadu Films handles personal information when you use mdadufilms.com, create a member account, build a talent profile, upload portfolio material, apply to projects or casting opportunities, submit a career application, or contact us. It should be read together with our Terms & Conditions.

## 2. Information we collect
We may collect account information such as your name, email address, mobile number, login and security information; profile information such as profession, city, gender, date of birth, skills, languages, experience, availability, biography and previous work; media and links you choose to provide such as profile photographs, portfolio images, showreels, social links and resumes; application information such as cover notes, pitches, selected portfolio items and supporting documents; and information you provide through contact or career forms. We also process limited technical and security data needed to operate sessions, prevent abuse and protect the platform.

## 3. How we use information
We use personal information to provide and secure accounts, operate the talent community, display profiles according to your visibility settings, process project and casting applications, manage saved talent lists for authorised administrators, respond to enquiries, review career applications, send service-related emails, maintain platform integrity, investigate misuse, and improve the reliability and usability of our services.

## 4. Public talent profiles and visibility
Your member workspace includes a public-profile visibility control. When public visibility is enabled, approved profile fields such as your name, professional information, city, skills, languages, experience, availability, profile photograph, portfolio, showreel and selected public links may be visible to website visitors and casting teams. Your account email address, mobile number, exact date of birth, private resume/document uploads, session information and private application notes are not intended to appear on the public talent profile. You can turn public visibility off from member settings.

## 5. Applications, resumes and portfolio material
When you apply for a project or casting opportunity, M. Dadu Films administrators may review the information and media you submit for production and casting purposes. Supporting PDF documents and resumes are treated as private application/profile material and are not intended to be publicly listed. Submitting an application does not guarantee selection, employment, engagement or payment.

## 6. Contact and career submissions
If you send a contact enquiry or career application, we use the information you provide to review and respond to your request. Career links should be shareable HTTPS links that you are authorised to provide. Contact and career records may be retained for operational, hiring, dispute-resolution or record-keeping needs.

## 7. Cookies, sessions and security
We use essential cookies and similar session mechanisms to keep you signed in, protect requests against forgery and manage account security. Session records may include hashed network/device signals and a coarse device label. We do not use these essential security records to publish your identity or device information.

## 8. Sharing of information
We do not sell your personal information to advertisers. Information may be accessible to authorised M. Dadu Films administrators and production/casting personnel where necessary for the services you request. We may also use infrastructure and service providers that process data on our behalf, and may disclose information where required by law, to protect rights or safety, to investigate abuse, or as part of a legitimate business reorganisation subject to applicable safeguards.

## 9. Storage, security and retention
We use reasonable technical and organisational measures designed to protect personal information. Uploaded storage is designed to remain private by default, with access controls for private documents. No system can guarantee absolute security. We retain information for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this policy, account administration, legal obligations, security, dispute resolution and legitimate business records, and may delete or anonymise information when it is no longer required.

## 10. Your choices and rights
You can update many account and profile fields from your member workspace, control public talent visibility, manage portfolio material and sessions, and deactivate your account. You may contact us to ask about access, correction or deletion of personal information, subject to applicable law and legitimate retention requirements. Deactivation may not immediately erase records that must be retained for security, legal, accounting, dispute or application-history purposes.

## 11. Children and authorised submissions
The platform is not designed to enable a child to publish personal information without appropriate authority. If information relating to a minor is submitted for a production or casting purpose, the person submitting it must have the authority and any parent or guardian consent required by applicable law. Please contact us before submitting sensitive information about a minor if you are unsure whether the platform workflow is appropriate.

## 12. Third-party links and services
The platform may link to third-party websites, social networks, showreels, portfolios or other services. Their privacy practices are controlled by those third parties. Review their policies before providing information to them.

## 13. Changes to this policy
We may update this Privacy Policy as the platform, our services or legal requirements change. The current version and effective date will be published on this page. Material changes may also be communicated through an appropriate service notice.

## 14. Contact
For privacy questions or requests, contact M. Dadu Films at m.dadufilms@gmail.com. Public business contact numbers are +91 92116 19085 and +91 96281 80620. M. Dadu Films operates from Lucknow and Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India.

terms.description: Terms governing use of the M. Dadu Films website, member community, talent profiles, projects, casting opportunities and related services.
body:
## 1. Agreement to these Terms
These Terms & Conditions govern your use of mdadufilms.com and the M. Dadu Films member, talent, casting, project, career and contact features. By creating an account or using the platform, you agree to these Terms and acknowledge the Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not create an account or use restricted platform features.

## 2. Accounts and accurate information
You are responsible for providing accurate information, keeping your account credentials secure and promptly updating material changes. You may not impersonate another person, create accounts using information you are not authorised to use, share credentials in a way that undermines account security, or attempt to gain access to another person's account or private records.

## 3. Talent profiles and public visibility
Members can create profiles and portfolios for creative and production opportunities. Public visibility is controlled through member settings. If you enable it, you authorise M. Dadu Films to display the approved public profile fields and media you submit for that purpose. You remain responsible for having the rights and permissions necessary to publish your profile text, photographs, portfolio material, showreels and external links.

## 4. Projects, casting calls and applications
Project and casting information is provided for legitimate creative and production workflows. Deadlines, requirements, compensation descriptions and availability may change. An application is an expression of interest only and does not create an employment relationship, engagement, agency relationship, guarantee of audition, guarantee of selection, or guarantee of payment. Any final commercial engagement should be governed by the separate written terms agreed for that production.

## 5. Career applications and enquiries
Submitting a career application or contact enquiry does not create an offer of employment, contract or obligation to respond. You must only provide resumes, portfolio links, contact details and other material that you are authorised to share.

## 6. Your content and permissions
You retain ownership of content you own. By uploading or submitting content to the platform, you grant M. Dadu Films a non-exclusive, limited permission to host, process, reproduce and display that content only as reasonably necessary to operate the platform, show a public profile when you enable visibility, review applications, manage production/casting workflows, maintain backups and security, and provide the services you request. This permission ends when the content is deleted from active systems, subject to reasonable backup, legal and record-retention requirements.

## 7. Prohibited use
You must not use the platform for unlawful, fraudulent, abusive, harassing, discriminatory or deceptive activity; upload malware or harmful code; scrape or harvest personal information without authorisation; bypass access controls or rate limits; test or exploit security vulnerabilities without written permission; submit content that infringes intellectual-property, privacy or publicity rights; misrepresent casting, employment or payment opportunities; or use another person's private information without authority.

## 8. Intellectual property of the platform
The M. Dadu Films name, branding, site design, original editorial material and platform content owned by M. Dadu Films are protected by applicable intellectual-property laws. Except where a separate licence applies, you may not copy, republish, sell or commercially exploit protected platform material without permission.

## 9. Third-party material and links
Showreels, social profiles, portfolios, external media and other third-party links are provided for convenience or user-submitted reference. M. Dadu Films does not control third-party services and is not responsible for their availability, content, security, terms or privacy practices.

## 10. Platform availability and changes
We may update, suspend, limit or discontinue features for maintenance, security, legal, operational or product reasons. We do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free availability. We may remove content or restrict an account where reasonably necessary to protect the platform, users, productions, legal rights or security.

## 11. Verification and moderation
A verification badge or administrative review means only that the platform has applied its current internal verification process. It is not a guarantee of a person's identity, qualifications, conduct, suitability, availability or performance. Users and production teams remain responsible for appropriate due diligence before entering into any engagement.

## 12. Disclaimer
To the extent permitted by applicable law, the platform is provided on an “as available” basis. M. Dadu Films does not promise that every listing, profile, application, external link or user-supplied statement will be complete, current or error-free. Nothing on the platform should be treated as legal, financial, employment or professional advice.

## 13. Limitation and responsibility
Nothing in these Terms excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded. To the extent permitted by applicable law, M. Dadu Films is not responsible for indirect or consequential losses arising solely from use of the platform, third-party services, user-submitted content, missed opportunities or decisions made independently by users. Each user remains responsible for their own submissions, communications, agreements and conduct.

## 14. Suspension and termination
You may deactivate your member account through the available account controls. M. Dadu Films may suspend or restrict access where there is suspected abuse, fraud, security risk, material breach of these Terms, legal requirement or conduct that could harm users, productions or the platform. Certain records may be retained as described in the Privacy Policy.

## 15. Governing law
These Terms are governed by applicable laws of India. Any dispute will be subject to the jurisdiction of a court that has lawful jurisdiction under applicable Indian law, unless the parties agree to another lawful dispute-resolution process in writing.

## 16. Changes and contact
We may update these Terms as services change. The current version and effective date will be published on this page. Questions about these Terms can be sent to m.dadufilms@gmail.com. Public business contact numbers are +91 92116 19085 and +91 96281 80620.
